detail.descriptionHtml:
Product Name:

GHPR-2 (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide-2)

Chemical Information:
  • Molecular Formula: C45H55N9O6
  • Molecular Weight: 817.97 g/mol
  • Sequence: H-D-Ala-D-2-Nal-Ala-Trp-D-Phe-Lys-NH2
  • Molecular Structure:
Product Description:

GHPR-2 (Growth Hormone Releasing Peptide-2) is a synthetic hexapeptide composed of a defined amino acid sequence produced through controlled peptide synthesis. It is provided exclusively for in vitro laboratory research in qualified experimental settings. The compound is structurally characterized and utilized in controlled environments for analytical and experimental evaluation under non-clinical conditions. It is supplied in lyophilized powder form to support stability and integrity during storage and handling.

Research Applications:

GHPR-2 is utilized in controlled laboratory research settings for applications such as:

  • Analytical evaluation of peptide structure and sequence characteristics
  • Examination of peptide stability and degradation profiles under defined conditions
  • Investigation of peptide behavior in biochemical and in vitro assay systems
  • Characterization of peptide interactions within controlled experimental models
Storage and Handling:
  • Store lyophilized powder at -20°C.
  • Once reconstituted, store at 2-8°C and use promptly.
  • Maintain aseptic techniques during laboratory protocols.
Product Specifications:
  • Purity: ≥99% (HPLC Certified)
  • Appearance: Lyophilized white powder
  • Solubility: Soluble in suitable laboratory agents
Compliance Notice:

GHPR-2 is FOR RESEARCH USE ONLY. It is not intended for human or veterinary use. This product has not been evaluated by the FDA. Misuse of this product is strictly prohibited and may violate federal, state, or local laws. By purchasing this product, buyer represents and warrants that it will be used only for in vitro research purposes.
